request.subject: UNIT:CULT:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the brightness of the blue cloth: make the whole hood and robe lighter, a soft bright indigo, colour #5d56cc on the lit left side and #443cab in the folds and on the shaded right side, with no dark navy anywhere on the cloth. Keep the black inside of the hood, the two big round cream eyes, the candle with its green flame, the paper scroll, the badge, the slippers, the shape, the thick black outline and the art style the same, on a transparent background.
